description: Web: rebuild the ACTIVITY LOG from a flat one-line stream into a structured, filterable, grouped view, and apply two layout changes. Adds a pure category mapper, call/result pairing, a turn-block model, a filter+search state model, the rebuilt rendering, the chip bar + search + collapsible-guide markup, and all supporting CSS. Depends on FEAT-001 for tool_result field semantics (tool/label/tag/callId). All rendering stays textContent-only (S1); the signature green (--green) is NOT used for active chips or success rows. Grounded in web/src/main.ts (reuse LEGEND_SWATCH, ROOM_ICON, relativeTime, ROOMS[id].label, resolveRoom; replace addActivity; remove logBubble) and web/src/rooms.ts (resolveRoom aliases po->founder).
steps: Confirm web/src/socket.ts ActivityEvent covers kind/room/tool/ok/tag/callId/detail/question (it does). Edit only if a consumed field is missing.

In web/src/main.ts, add the pure category layer (A1/D2): `type Category = 'read'|'write'|'run'|'test'|'commit'|'web'|'plan'|'approve'|'done'|'other'`; a hard-coded CATEGORY lookup giving each a KO label + icon per design §1 (읽기👀 작성✏️ 실행⌨️ 테스트🧪 커밋🚀 웹🌐 계획📝 승인✋ 완료✅ 기타•) with ASCII/emoji constants only (never from payload); and `export function categoryOf(ev: ActivityEvent): Category` implementing §1 precedence exactly. Import resolveRoom from './rooms.js' and narrow `const r = ev.room ? resolveRoom(ev.room) : null` before any room switch. Order: turn_end->done; pending_interaction & interaction_resolved->approve; tag==='test'->test; tag==='commit'->commit; tool_call/tool_result-> spec-room guard (r==='meeting' && write-set tool -> plan) then tool-name sets (read:read_file/read_code/grep_search/file_search/list_directory; write:str_replace/fs_write/fs_append/semantic_rename/smart_relocate/create_artifact; run:execute_bash/control_bash_process/get_process_output; web:remote_web_search/web_fetch; plan:run_workflow/update_workflow/inspect_workflow/validate_workflow/send_message/todo_list/update_session_information) with result tool-recovery via the paired call then room fallback; assistant+label==='thinking'->plan, plain assistant->other; room fallback switch (archive->read, dev->write, server->run, test->test, research->web, meeting->plan, founder->approve, corridor/lobby/null->other); default other.

In web/src/main.ts, add the pure log model (C1/C2/C3-out/D6/D7): `interface LogRow {key,ev,category,status:'pending'|'ok'|'fail'|'none',resultTs?}` and `interface TurnBlock {id,startTs,endTs?,open,rows:LogRow[],counts:Partial<Record<Category,number>>}`; module state `let blocks: TurnBlock[]` (newest-first), `const pairIndex = new Map<string,LogRow>()` (cap 256, FIFO evict), `const toggled = new Set<string>()` (session-only). Implement `applyEvent(ev)`: turn_start closes the open block (open=false) and prepends a new open block; a work event routes into the current open block or creates a synthetic loose block (id 'loose:*', open:true, no header, always expanded) when none is open; build/pair a LogRow (tool_call w/ callId -> pending row in pairIndex; tool_result w/ matching callId -> update that row in place: status from ev.ok, resultTs, tool recovery, remove from index, do NOT re-count; orphan/no-callId -> standalone row) and bump counts[category] on new rows only; turn_end sets endTs/open=false and adds a done count. Enforce the 200-row cap across all blocks (walk oldest-first, drop trailing rows then empty blocks until total <=200). Add `fmtDuration(ms)` ('2분 12초'/'47초'/'1시간 3분') and `isExpanded(b) = toggled.has(b.id) ? !b.open : b.open`. C3 run-collapsing is OUT (design §3). Keep this layer DOM-free.

In web/src/main.ts, add the filter+search model (B1-B4): `interface LogFilter {cats:Set<Category>,q:string}` + module `filter`; `function rowVisible(row,f)` = (f.cats.size===0 || f.cats.has(row.category)) && (!f.q || `${row.ev.label} ${row.ev.detail??''} ${row.ev.tool??''}`.toLowerCase().includes(f.q.toLowerCase())). Load on startup from localStorage keys 'ko.activity.filter.cats' (JSON array, empty=전체) and 'ko.activity.filter.q' (string) BEFORE first render; persist on every change (debounce the search ~200ms). Structural rows (approve/done, block headers) survive category filtering; a block with zero visible rows is not rendered.

In web/index.html, add markup (B1/L1): inside #activity.panel after .panel-head, a `.activity-controls` wrapper with a `.chip-bar` of chips 전체·읽기·작성·실행·테스트·웹·계획 (전체 is the reset chip with no data-cat; others `.chip` with data-cat='read'|'write'|'run'|'test'|'web'|'plan') and an `input.activity-search` (placeholder '검색'); keep #activity-list after it. In #floor-guide .panel-head add `<button id="guide-toggle" class="panel-toggle" aria-label="층별 안내 접기">«</button>`.

In web/src/main.ts, rebuild rendering and wire interactions (C1/C2/D1-D7/B-render/L1): replace addActivity with `renderLog()` that renders blocks newest-first into #activity-list — each block a <li> with a clickable summary header (▸/▾ caret, HH:MM start via toLocaleTimeString('ko-KR',{hour12:false}), per-category counts in §1 order joined by ' · ' omitting zeros and done/other, duration via fmtDuration or '진행 중 · …' when open with a `.block-dur` span) and, when isExpanded, its visible rows. Each row: fluid grid (colorbar|icon|label(+target)|time/outcome); color bar from LEGEND_SWATCH[ev.room as RoomId] ?? 'transparent' (RAW id, not resolved); icon CATEGORY[categoryOf(ev)].icon; room KO label via ROOMS[resolveRoom(ev.room)!].label (not '[po]'); time relativeTime(ev.ts) with absolute time in a title attr; ✅/❌ by status; red bar+❌ on status==='fail', amber bar on approve, success uses neutral ink — NEVER green. Loose blocks render header-less, always expanded (flat-list parity). Apply rowVisible at render time. Remove the logBubble() call from applyBubble and delete the logBubble function + lastBubbleLog var (applyBubble keeps only the 3D bubble + header status). Update onCatchup to rebuild the model (reset blocks/pairIndex, applyEvent over f.events) then renderLog; update onEvent to applyEvent(f.event) then renderLog (keep noteActivity/applyBubble/react/setRoom/renderStats). Add `setInterval(renderOpenBlockHeader, 15000)` that rewrites only the open block's .block-dur textContent (no-op when none open); do NOT modify the existing setInterval(renderFloors,15000). Wire: chip clicks (toggle filter.cats; 전체 clears to empty; persist + renderLog), search input (debounced persist + renderLog), guide-toggle (document.getElementById('app').classList.toggle('guide-collapsed'); persist 'ko.guide.collapsed' '1'|'0'; call office.resize() on transitionend or setTimeout 240), block-header click (flip toggled membership then renderLog). On startup restore persisted filter + collapsed state before first paint.

In web/src/style.css, add the CSS (B1/D1/D5/L1/L2): set `#app { grid-template-columns: 260px 1fr 360px; transition: grid-template-columns .22s ease; }` and `#app.guide-collapsed { grid-template-columns: 44px 1fr 360px; }` plus `#app.guide-collapsed #floor-guide .follow-toggle, #app.guide-collapsed #floor-guide .floor-list { display:none }`. Add .activity-controls (pinned under panel head), .chip-bar, .chip[data-cat] and .chip.active (active = --ink text + --panel-2 fill + border; NOT green), .activity-search. Add .activity-row grid-template-columns:auto auto 1fr auto; gap:6px 8px; a 3px left color bar; label overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;word-break:keep-all. Add block header + .block-dur + caret styles. Emphasis: .activity-row.fail bar+❌ red (hsl(2 60% 52%)-ish, reuse the oops family), .activity-row.approve bar amber (hsl(24 85% 62%)); success neutral ink, never --green. Add .panel-head flex + .panel-toggle button + the 44px collapsed-rail look. Keep .activity-list overflow-y:auto;flex:1 so only rows scroll. The .bubble-line rule may be removed or left unused.
acceptance_criteria: `cd web && npm run build` (`tsc && vite build`) completes cleanly with no type or bundle errors (V2).
categoryOf, rowVisible, and applyEvent are exported/pure and type-check; categoryOf maps per the §1 table (A1/D2).

The chip bar 전체·읽기·작성·실행·테스트·웹·계획 is present and multi-select with 전체 reset; a case-insensitive search filters over label/detail/tool; filter+search persist in localStorage and re-apply to catch-up and live (B1-B4).
tool_call+tool_result with the same callId render as ONE row with icon+action+target+✅/❌; unpaired call shows pending; orphans render without crashing (C1).

Events between turn_start/turn_end form a collapsible block with a one-line count+duration header, newest-first, open block expanded by default, with an ungrouped loose-block fallback when markers are missing (C2); run-collapsing omitted (C3).

Rows show a LEGEND_SWATCH color bar keyed by raw room, a category icon, the KO room label, relativeTime with absolute-time title, red/amber emphasis for fail/approve (never green), newest-first, 200-row model cap (D1-D7).
The FLOOR GUIDE collapses to a thin rail via its panel-head toggle with a visible reopen affordance and persisted state; the log column is 360px and readable at old+new widths (L1/L2).
No innerHTML/insertAdjacentHTML/eval/new Function anywhere in the new/changed web code; all log text via textContent (S1).
verification: cd web && npm run build  — tsc type-check + vite bundle both clean (V2).

Manual (V3) against real/replayed logs: paired rows show ✅/❌, blocks summarize+collapse, filters+search persist and re-apply live, guide collapses/reopens, log reads well at 360px. Grep the changed web files to confirm no innerHTML/eval were introduced (S1 spot-check, not a substitute for the build gate).
findings:
DONE. The ACTIVITY LOG was rebuilt in web/src/main.ts from a flat prepend stream into a structured, filterable, grouped view. index.html + style.css carry the markup/CSS. socket.ts needed NO change (ActivityEvent already covers kind/room/tool/ok/tag/callId/detail/question). Only main.ts, index.html, style.css were touched.

WHAT LANDED (all layers in main.ts):
- Category layer (A1/D2): exported `type Category` + hard-coded `CATEGORY` table (KO label + emoji/ASCII icon per §1: 읽기👀 작성✏️ 실행⌨️ 테스트🧪 커밋🚀 웹🌐 계획📝 승인✋ 완료✅ 기타•), all constants local — never from payload. `export function categoryOf(ev)` implements §1 precedence exactly: turn_end→done; pending_interaction & interaction_resolved→approve; tag==='test'→test; tag==='commit'→commit (so the FEAT-001 test-runner expansion — pytest/go test/cargo test/rspec — flows through via ev.tag with no web-side regex); tool events → meeting-room write guard→plan, then tool-name sets (read/write/run/web/plan), then room fallback; assistant+thinking→plan else other; room-fallback switch (archive→read, dev→write, server→run, test→test, research→web, meeting→plan, founder→approve, corridor/lobby/null→other). `resolveRoom` narrows `ev.room` before any room switch (aliases po→founder).
- Pure model (C1/C2/D6/D7): `LogRow` + `TurnBlock`, module `blocks` (newest-first), `pairIndex` Map (cap 256 FIFO), session-only `toggled` Set. `applyEvent(ev)`: turn_start closes open blocks + prepends a new open block; a work event routes into the open block or a synthetic `loose:*` block (header-less, always expanded) when no turn is open; tool_call w/ callId → pending row registered in pairIndex; tool_result w/ matching callId → updates that row IN PLACE (status from ev.ok, resultTs, tool recovery when the call had no name, tag carry-over) and does NOT re-count; orphan/no-callId result → standalone row. counts bump on NEW rows only; turn_end sets endTs/open=false + a done count. 200-row cap walks oldest-first dropping rows then emptied non-open blocks. `fmtDuration` ('2분 12초'/'47초'/'1시간 3분') and `isExpanded(b)=toggled.has(b.id)?!b.open:b.open`. Layer is DOM-free. C3 run-collapsing intentionally omitted (§3).
- Filter+search (B1-B4): `LogFilter {cats,q}` + exported pure `rowVisible(row,f)` = catOk && substring over `label+detail+tool` lowercased. approve/done rows are structural and survive category filtering (via rowVisibleStructural at render). Loaded from localStorage ('ko.activity.filter.cats' JSON array, 'ko.activity.filter.q') BEFORE first paint; persisted on change with the search debounced ~200ms.
- Rendering (C1/C2/D1-D7/B/L1): `renderLog()` renders blocks newest-first — each grouped block a clickable summary header (▸/▾ caret, HH:MM start, §1-ordered counts joined by ' · ' omitting done/other + zeros, duration via fmtDuration or '진행 중 · …' in a .block-dur span) + its visible rows when expanded; loose blocks render header-less/always-expanded. Each row is a fluid grid (colorbar|icon|label(+target)|time/outcome): bar from LEGEND_SWATCH[RAW ev.room] ?? transparent; icon from CATEGORY[categoryOf(ev)]; KO room label via ROOMS[resolveRoom(ev.room)!].label; relativeTime with absolute time in a title attr; ✅/❌/… by status; .fail→red bar+label+❌, .approve→amber bar, success uses neutral ink — NEVER --green. All text via textContent/append(string) (S1).
- logBubble() + lastBubbleLog deleted; applyBubble now only drives the 3D bubble + header status. onCatchup resets blocks/pairIndex, replays applyEvent over f.events, then renderLog once. onEvent calls applyEvent→renderLog (noteActivity/applyBubble/react/setRoom/renderStats preserved). Added `setInterval(renderOpenBlockHeader,15000)` that rewrites only the open block's .block-dur textContent; the existing renderFloors interval is untouched.
- Wiring: chip clicks (전체 clears to empty = multi-select reset; others toggle; persist+syncChipUI+renderLog), debounced search, guide-toggle (toggles #app.guide-collapsed, persists 'ko.guide.collapsed', swaps «/», calls office.resize() on transitionend + a 240ms fallback), block-header click flips toggled membership. Persisted filter + collapsed state restored before first paint.

markup (index.html): `.activity-controls` wrapper (chip-bar 전체·읽기·작성·실행·테스트·웹·계획 with data-cat, plus input.activity-search placeholder '검색') after #activity .panel-head; `#guide-toggle.panel-toggle` button in #floor-guide .panel-head.
CSS (style.css): #app columns 260/1fr/360 with .22s transition; #app.guide-collapsed → 44px rail hiding h2/sub/follow-toggle/floor-list; .panel-toggle button; .activity-controls/.chip-bar/.chip (active = --ink text + --panel-2 fill + --faint border, NOT green)/.activity-search; .activity-block + .block-head/.block-caret/.block-time/.block-counts/.block-dur; .activity-row grid auto auto 1fr auto with a 3px .row-bar, ellipsised keep-all .row-label; .activity-row.fail (red hsl(2 60% 52%)) + .activity-row.approve (amber hsl(24 85% 62%)); success neutral, never --green. Old .activity-item/.bubble-line rules removed.

VERIFY: `cd web && npm run build` (tsc && vite build) → CLEAN (0 type/bundle errors; the >500kB three.js chunk warning is pre-existing and unrelated). S1 grep over web/src/*.ts → the only innerHTML/eval match is the existing header comment; no forbidden API introduced. categoryOf + rowVisible are exported & pure. V3 manual replay is left for the human (no live watcher in this step). SCOPE: palette invariant honored — --green stays reserved for LIVE/active-room/character; active chips use --ink/--panel-2 and success rows use neutral ink.
